data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact's calibration analogy abstracts the general mechanism of rule-mediated reliability: any rule artifact (checklist, navigator, instrument) must exhibit non-empty divergence from a baseline judgment and independently verifiable correctness to isolate its causal contribution, reducing the checklist-panel evaluation to an instance of this broader calibration schema. This abstraction is refuted if the checklist's correctness cannot be independently verified against an objective outcome, collapsing the analogy to a mere coherence check.
